HOME SCIENCE MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Special Treatment in Laundry Work? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Special Treatment in Laundry Work.

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting.

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Careers in Food and Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Careers in Food and Nutrition.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.

12. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Maternal Health care and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Child Health Care and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Careers in Home Management 3.0 Clothing and Textiles 3.1 Clothing Construction P and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Careers in Home Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Special Treatment in Laundry Work.

2. C — Glucose and oxygen

3. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting.

4. D — newton (N)

5. A — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

6. C — Producers

7. D — 100 °C

8. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.

9. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection.

10. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Careers in Food and Nutrition.

11. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.

12. C — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Maternal Health care; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Child Health Care; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Careers in Home Management 3.0 Clothing and Textiles 3.1 Clothing Construction P; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Careers in Home Management; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
